About Render

Render Network is a decentralized GPU marketplace that connects people who need 3D rendering and AI compute with node operators who have spare GPU capacity. RENDER pays for that work.

Where this RENDER price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (RENDER-USD), Binance (RENDER/USDT) and Kraken (RENDER/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 518,129,000 RENDER (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
